commit.message:
Refactor Scrobble UI and add phosphor image filter

Replace the small "LIVE" badge with a "NOW PLAYING" label and simplify the Scrobble card markup (move artwork out of the group wrapper, clamp title to 2 lines, add hover brightness). Convert recent tracks to a 2-column grid with right-aligned artist names. Add an SVG "phosphor" color filter to Layout.astro and corresponding .phosphor-filter CSS with a hover transition in global.css to style album artwork and improve visuals.
